notes: Safer files, and a quicker page list

entries.title: Safer files, and a quicker page list
entries.detail: A stored file that could run code, such as an HTML or SVG file, now downloads instead of opening in a browser tab. In the Mac app, a program, script or installer shows in the Finder instead of opening. A picture added to a Markdown file whose _assets folder is not there yet now goes into that folder. folia reads your page list in fewer, quicker steps.

entries.title: scripta writes into the page you prepared
entries.detail: scripta's minutes, Prepare and the meetings panel find a meeting's page also when the calendar changed the meeting's id, had the meeting twice, or the page was made by hand for that day. A new page for the meeting goes to the section of its series.

entries.title: Changes by others are marked row by row in tables
entries.detail: When someone changes a cell, the bar beside the page now marks only that row, not the whole table. Rows in a row changed by one person share one bar, and ⌘G and the arrows go from row to row.

entries.title: Briefs are read in a moment
entries.detail: folia now keeps one Cerebrum reader open instead of starting it for every question. A page that has no brief yet gets one in about a second, and the pass over your ETH pages takes minutes instead of hours.

entries.title: A brief on every page of your ETH notebooks, on both Macs
entries.detail: With Brief from Cerebrum on, every page of your ETH notebooks gets the folded brief card: what Cerebrum knows about its topic, the open items, and what was still open on the page before it in the section. folia reads the missing briefs one page at a time, the newest first; Settings › Armarium shows how far it is. The briefs are kept in your Cerebrum vault, in its own folder briefs, so your other Mac shows them too without reading them again.

entries.title: Align text left, centre, right or justified and 2 more
entries.detail: Align text left, centre, right or justified: As in Word, for text and headings: add the four tools to the toolbar in Settings › Toolbar, or give them keys in Settings › Keys. A second press of Centre, Right or Justify goes back to left. The alignment stays in History, copies and templates, and the Markdown copy writes it as GitHub does. Lists, quotes and tables keep their own alignment. Choose the tools above a selection: Settings › Toolbar now also sets what shows above selected words: the font colours as before, and any of Bold, Italic, Link, the alignments, headings, lists and more, in your order. Its switch moved there from Settings › General. ⌘G goes through the changes by others: With nothing in the search field, ⌘G goes to the next place someone else changed on the open page, and ⇧⌘G to the one before. With words in the search field, ⌘G still goes through the hits.

entries.title: A person's face beside their changes
entries.detail: The bars beside what others wrote now carry the person's face from Settings › Users: the first letter of their address, in their colour. The line under the title and Share use the same face. A colour chosen in Settings › Users shows on the page at once. Beside older text the bar is lighter, the face stays in full colour.

entries.title: Who wrote what, whenever you want
entries.detail: Switch on Who wrote what in Settings › General, or in ⌘K: every page then shows a bar beside everything others wrote, in their colour, not only what is new. What is new since you last read the page stays bright, the rest is lighter.

entries.title: People in their own colour, as in tabula
entries.detail: Settings › Users now looks like tabula's: each person a coloured letter, and the admin picks their colour from folia's notebook colours. That colour is how everyone sees the person in folia: their cursor, the marks of their changes, their face in the change line and in Share. Without a choice, folia picks one from the address.

entries.title: Briefs are read ahead
entries.detail: With Brief from Cerebrum on, folia reads the briefs of today's and the next seven days' meetings by itself, half a minute after it starts and then every half hour, so Brief and the meeting page's card open at once. A brief older than a day is read again.

entries.title: See what a coworker changed
entries.detail: A page someone else changed since you last read it has a dot in their colour in the page list, and its section and notebook count it. On the page, a line under the title says who changed how many places and when, with arrows to go from place to place and Mark as seen; a bar in the right margin, with their initials, marks each place. What they type while you read shows at once.

entries.title: The brief is kept, and folded into the meeting page
entries.detail: A meeting page now has a folded Brief from Cerebrum card under its meeting line: one line says when it was read and what it holds, and a press opens it. The brief is read once and kept on this Mac, so it opens at once, here and with Brief in Meetings; Read again asks Cerebrum anew. It is never saved in the page and never sent.

entries.title: Open a brief's items in specula
entries.detail: In the brief and in Minutes and Cerebrum, press the name of a person, a topic or an open item, and specula shows it.

entries.title: Open items from Cerebrum say since when
entries.detail: In the brief and in Minutes and Cerebrum, each open item from your Cerebrum vault now says since when it is open, for example open since 12.03.2026.

entries.title: Minutes and Cerebrum on a meeting page
entries.detail: With Brief from Cerebrum on, a meeting page with scripta's minutes has a Minutes and Cerebrum button on its meeting line. It shows what earlier meetings of the series already had open, the people and projects the minutes name, and the decisions and open points beside what your Cerebrum vault holds. Prepare, Open and Brief in Meetings now share one width and line up. Like the brief, it is read on this Mac and never goes into a page.

entries.title: A brief from Cerebrum before a meeting
entries.detail: Switch on Brief from Cerebrum in Settings › Armarium, and each meeting in Meetings gets a Brief button beside Prepare. It shows the people, the related topics and the open items your Cerebrum vault has, and the open tasks and decisions of the series' last page. The brief is read on this Mac and shown in a window of its own: it never goes into a page.

entries.title: Make Markdown files on your Mac, in Files
entries.detail: In the Mac app, Files under On this Mac makes new Markdown files. The first time, folia asks for a folder and keeps it. Files and opened folders now have new folders, templates, Move and Copy to folder, drag a file onto a folder, and sorting by name or date. Pictures and links keep working when a file moves.

entries.title: Minutes from scripta no longer blank a page
entries.detail: When scripta sent other minutes with no decisions or tasks, a meeting page could show nothing. Its text was safe, and it shows again once scripta sends the minutes once more.

entries.title: The header buttons look like tabula's New task button
entries.detail: The buttons at the top right are small amber tiles. Pointing lights their edge, and a button that is pressed or on turns full amber.

entries.title: Get the Mac app is now in About
entries.detail: Settings › About folia now holds the download of the Mac app. In a browser the Mac app part is gone, as it held nothing else. In the Mac app, that part keeps its hotkey, its icon and opening at login.

entries.title: Set up the toolbar yourself
entries.detail: Settings › Toolbar shows the toolbar and a pool of tools. Click a tool to move it between them, or drag it to place it. Strikethrough waits in the pool. Each Mac and browser keeps its own toolbar.

entries.title: Inline code is back in the toolbar, Strikethrough has left it
entries.detail: The toolbar has Inline code right of Font colour. Strikethrough has no button now: type ~~ around a word, or set a key in Settings › Keys.

entries.title: About folia is laid out as in tabula
entries.detail: Settings › About folia shows the build facts in two columns. The About tab counts the changes you have not read. The foot of Settings names the build.

entries.title: A done task's text turns green
entries.detail: When you tick a task, its text turns green, like its check. A font colour that you set yourself stays.

entries.title: A done task gets a green check
entries.detail: In a task list, a done task now shows a round green check on its icon. Its text no longer has a line through it. A strike through that you set yourself stays.

entries.title: Settings as large as in tabula, with the build facts in About
entries.detail: The Settings window has the size of tabula's, and shrinks to fit a smaller window. Settings › About folia shows the build code, build number, build date, when folia started, and the builds of the web app and the Mac app.

entries.title: Font colours above a selection, and one list of colours
entries.detail: Select words in a page, and the font colours show right above them. Settings › General can switch that off. Font colours are now the same 11 colours as notebooks and sections, in the same order. In text each one is only as much darker or lighter as it needs to read well.

entries.title: Settings › tabula is called Armarium
entries.detail: The part of Settings that sends your tasks is now called Armarium. Its switch and what it does stay as they were.

entries.title: Font colours, and orange for notebooks and sections
entries.detail: The toolbar has Font colour where Code stood: select words, press the A with the bar, and pick a colour, or pick one first and type. Each colour reads well in the light and the dark look, and Default colour takes it off. Inline code stays: type it between backticks. Notebooks and sections can now be orange too.

entries.title: j4k is called tabula now
entries.detail: Settings › j4k is now Settings › tabula, and its switch Tasks to tabula. Your switch and your name in task lines stay as they were, and your tasks go to Review in tabula as before.

entries.title: Delete your templates
entries.detail: New page from a template now has Manage templates…. It lists your templates and where each one is. Delete puts the page into the bin for 30 days. Stop using keeps the page. Pages you made from a template stay as they are.

entries.title: Page templates of your own
entries.detail: Write a page as you like it, and choose Use as template in its … menu. It then shows under New page from a template, and Prepare offers it for a meeting. A meeting prepared from a template keeps its link, so scripta writes its minutes under the headings of your template, also under German ones such as Aufgaben or Beschlüsse.

entries.title: A tick in folia finishes the task in j4k
entries.detail: A task that went to j4k and that you tick in folia now goes to Done in j4k, within about three minutes. A task with an open subtask or a repeat in j4k stays open: finish it there.

entries.title: While you search, the columns show where the hits are
entries.detail: Each notebook and section shows how many pages it has with your words, and each page how many hits. Notebooks, sections and pages without any turn grey; nothing is hidden. Clear the search and the numbers go.

entries.title: Search filters: notebook, section, date, open tasks, tag
entries.detail: Under the search field, a row of filters narrows what you find: a notebook or a section (also the one you are in), a time (today, last 7 or 30 days, this year, last year, or between two days), where the words stand (titles, headings, open tasks, pictures and files, meetings), and a tag. Each choice shows how many pages it gives. Sort by best match or newest. Without any words, the filters list their pages, for example every open task of a section from the last week.

entries.title: Search shows "&" as "&"
entries.detail: A search hit no longer shows "&" where the page has "&", for example in "Q&A". The same goes for "<", ">", quotes and fixed spaces.

entries.title: Work offline: new pages, renames, moves, deletes and files
entries.detail: While folia cannot reach its database, everything you do still works: new pages and sections, renames, moves, deletes, colours, undo, and pictures and files you add. The changes wait on this device, also through a restart, and go in, in the order you made them, as soon as folia is back online. The status bar shows how many changes are waiting.

entries.title: Pages written offline reach the cloud by themselves
entries.detail: Text you write while folia cannot reach its servers now goes up by itself when they are back, also in pages you have closed since. The status bar says Saved only once your text is in the database; while the database cannot be reached it says Not saved yet, and your text stays safe on this device.

entries.title: Settings › Users, as in j4k
entries.detail: Only for the admin: everyone who may sign in to folia, each with Remove, and a field to add an address. Before, an address came on the list only when a notebook was shared with it, and nothing took one off.

entries.title: What's New opens once after an update
entries.detail: After an update, the Mac app shows What's New once. It no longer opens again each time you open a file from the Finder or the Dock, follow a link to a page, or bring the window back.
